ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_FinancialProduct_DEP
AS
BEGIN
WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct AS
(
	SELECT
		BDG.SCHM_CODE AS FinancialProductId
		,BDG.SCHM_DESC AS FinancialProductName
		,BDG.START_DATE AS ProductFirstSaleDate
		,BDG.END_DATE AS ActualAbandonmentDate
		,BDG.CUST_MIN_AGE AS MinimumAgeToOpenAccount
		,BDG.GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE AS LedgerId
		,BDG.TRAN_RPT_CODE_FLG AS TransactionReportCodeIndicator
		,BDG.TRAN_REF_NUM_FLG AS TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication
		,BDG.SCHM_SUPR_USER_ID AS EmployeeId
		,BDG.NEW_ACCT_DURATION AS NewAccountDuration
		,BDG.DORM_ACCT_CRITERIA AS DormantAccountCriteria
		,BDG.FX_TRAN_FLG AS FxTransactionIndicator
		,BDG.STP_CR_DR_IND AS StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator
		,BDG.FCNR_FLG AS FcnrIndicator
		,BDG.INT_PAID_COLL_CRNCY_FLG AS InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId
		,BDG.INTER_SOL_CLOSURE_ALWD_FLG AS InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator
		,BDG.ACCT_MAINT_PERIOD AS AccountMaintenancePeriod
		,BDG.MIN_COMMIT_CHRG_UTIL_PCNT AS MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent
		,BDG.COMMIT_CALC_METHOD AS CommitCalculationMethodId
		,BDG.INACTIVE_ACCT_CHRG_DAYS AS InactiveAccountChargeDays
		,BDG.INACTIVE_ACCT_CHRG_MNTHS AS InactiveAccountChargeMonths
		,BDG.DORMANT_ACCT_CHRG_DAYS AS DormantAccountChargeDays
		,BDG.DORMANT_ACCT_CHRG_MNTHS AS DormantAccountChargeMonths
		,BDG.PARTITION_MANDATORY_FLG AS PartitionMandatoryIndicator
		,BDG.BOOK_TRAN_SCRIPT AS BookTransactionScript
		,BDG.INTCALC_TRAN_SCRIPT AS InterestCalculationTransactionScript
		,BDG.DFLT_CLG_TRAN_CODE AS DefaultClearingTransactionId
		,BDG.DFLT_INST_TYPE AS DefaultInstrumentTypeId
		,BDG.EEFC_FLG AS EefcAccountIndicator
		,BDG.CS_SCHM_MESG1 AS CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1
		,BDG.CS_SCHM_MESG2 AS CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2
		,BDG.COMP_DATE_FLG AS CompoundingDateId
		,BDG.FIXEDTERM_MNTHS AS FixedTermMonths
		,BDG.FIXEDTERM_YEARS AS FixedTermYears
		,BDG.FLOAT_INT_TBL_CODE AS FloatingInterestTableId
		,BDG.FLOAT_REPRICING_FREQ_MNTHS AS FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths
		,BDG.FLOAT_REPRICING_FREQ_DAYS AS FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays
		,BDG.RULE_CODE AS RuleId
		,BDG.LOOKBACK_PERD_FOR_PASTDUE AS LookBackPeriodForPastDue
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDG.PEN_COLL_FLG AS PenaltyPayableIndicator
		,BDG.SCHM_NATURE AS FinancialProductNatureId
		,BDG.PS_FREQ_CAL_BASE AS PsFrequencyCalendarBase
		,BDG.ADDITIONAL_CAL_BASE AS AdditionalCalendarBase
		,BDG.MUD_POOL_PROD_FLG AS MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator
		,BDG.ALT1_SCHM_SHORT_NAME AS AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName
		,BDG.ALT1_SCHM_DESC AS AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription
		,BDG.PRODUCT_SRL_NUM AS FinancialProductSerialNumber
		,BDG.PRODUCT_ID AS GlobalFinancialProductId
		,BDG.ISLAMIC_PRODUCT_TYPE AS IslamicFinancialProductTypeId
		,BDG.ORG_CHNL_ID AS OriginationChannelId
		,BDG.SER_CHNL_ID AS ServicesChannelId
		,BDG.DEPOSIT_WINDOW_PERD AS DepositWindowPeriod
		,BDG.DEPOSIT_WIN_PERD_END_DATE AS DepositWindowPeriodEndDate
		,BDG.TOLERANCE_DEPOSIT_WIN_PERD AS ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate
		,BDG.COOLING_PERIOD_MNTHS AS CoolingPeriodMonths
		,BDG.COOLING_PERIOD_DAYS AS CoolingPeriodDays
		,BDG.PD_INDICATOR_FLG AS PdIndicatorId
		,BDG.FREEZ_INACTIVITY_PRD_MNTHS AS FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths
		,BDG.FREEZ_INACTIVITY_PRD_DAYS AS FreezeInactivityPeriodDays
		,BDG.RPC_PURPOSE AS RpcPurposeId
		,'DEP' AS SourceCode
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE BDG
		ON BDGD.SCHM_CODE = BDG.SCHM_CODE
        AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			FinancialProductId
			,FinancialProductName
			,ProductFirstSaleDate
			,ActualAbandonmentDate
			,MinimumAgeToOpenAccount
			,LedgerId
			,TransactionReportCodeIndicator
			,TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication
			,EmployeeId
			,NewAccountDuration
			,DormantAccountCriteria
			,FxTransactionIndicator
			,StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator
			,FcnrIndicator
			,InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId
			,InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator
			,AccountMaintenancePeriod
			,MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent
			,CommitCalculationMethodId
			,InactiveAccountChargeDays
			,InactiveAccountChargeMonths
			,DormantAccountChargeDays
			,DormantAccountChargeMonths
			,PartitionMandatoryIndicator
			,BookTransactionScript
			,InterestCalculationTransactionScript
			,DefaultClearingTransactionId
			,DefaultInstrumentTypeId
			,EefcAccountIndicator
			,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1
			,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2
			,CompoundingDateId
			,FixedTermMonths
			,FixedTermYears
			,FloatingInterestTableId
			,FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths
			,FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays
			,RuleId
			,LookBackPeriodForPastDue
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,PenaltyPayableIndicator
			,FinancialProductNatureId
			,PsFrequencyCalendarBase
			,AdditionalCalendarBase
			,MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator
			,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName
			,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription
			,FinancialProductSerialNumber
			,GlobalFinancialProductId
			,IslamicFinancialProductTypeId
			,OriginationChannelId
			,ServicesChannelId
			,DepositWindowPeriod
			,DepositWindowPeriodEndDate
			,ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate
			,CoolingPeriodMonths
			,CoolingPeriodDays
			,PdIndicatorId
			,FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths
			,FreezeInactivityPeriodDays
			,RpcPurposeId)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			FinancialProductId
			,FinancialProductName
			,ProductFirstSaleDate
			,ActualAbandonmentDate
			,MinimumAgeToOpenAccount
			,LedgerId
			,TransactionReportCodeIndicator
			,TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication
			,EmployeeId
			,NewAccountDuration
			,DormantAccountCriteria
			,FxTransactionIndicator
			,StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator
			,FcnrIndicator
			,InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId
			,InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator
			,AccountMaintenancePeriod
			,MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent
			,CommitCalculationMethodId
			,InactiveAccountChargeDays
			,InactiveAccountChargeMonths
			,DormantAccountChargeDays
			,DormantAccountChargeMonths
			,PartitionMandatoryIndicator
			,BookTransactionScript
			,InterestCalculationTransactionScript
			,DefaultClearingTransactionId
			,DefaultInstrumentTypeId
			,EefcAccountIndicator
			,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1
			,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2
			,CompoundingDateId
			,FixedTermMonths
			,FixedTermYears
			,FloatingInterestTableId
			,FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths
			,FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays
			,RuleId
			,LookBackPeriodForPastDue
			,FinancialInstitutionId
			,PenaltyPayableIndicator
			,FinancialProductNatureId
			,PsFrequencyCalendarBase
			,AdditionalCalendarBase
			,MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator
			,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName
			,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription
			,FinancialProductSerialNumber
			,GlobalFinancialProductId
			,IslamicFinancialProductTypeId
			,OriginationChannelId
			,ServicesChannelId
			,DepositWindowPeriod
			,DepositWindowPeriodEndDate
			,ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate
			,CoolingPeriodMonths
			,CoolingPeriodDays
			,PdIndicatorId
			,FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths
			,FreezeInactivityPeriodDays
			,RpcPurposeId)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialProductId,TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT TGT
	 ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
	FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId
	,FinancialProductName = SRC.FinancialProductName
	,ProductFirstSaleDate = SRC.ProductFirstSaleDate
	,ActualAbandonmentDate = SRC.ActualAbandonmentDate
	,MinimumAgeToOpenAccount = SRC.MinimumAgeToOpenAccount
	,LedgerId = SRC.LedgerId
	,TransactionReportCodeIndicator = SRC.TransactionReportCodeIndicator
	,TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication = SRC.TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication
	,EmployeeId = SRC.EmployeeId
	,NewAccountDuration = SRC.NewAccountDuration
	,DormantAccountCriteria = SRC.DormantAccountCriteria
	,FxTransactionIndicator = SRC.FxTransactionIndicator
	,StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator = SRC.StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator
	,FcnrIndicator = SRC.FcnrIndicator
	,InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId = SRC.InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId
	,InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator = SRC.InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator
	,AccountMaintenancePeriod = SRC.AccountMaintenancePeriod
	,MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent = SRC.MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent
	,CommitCalculationMethodId = SRC.CommitCalculationMethodId
	,InactiveAccountChargeDays = SRC.InactiveAccountChargeDays
	,InactiveAccountChargeMonths = SRC.InactiveAccountChargeMonths
	,DormantAccountChargeDays = SRC.DormantAccountChargeDays
	,DormantAccountChargeMonths = SRC.DormantAccountChargeMonths
	,PartitionMandatoryIndicator = SRC.PartitionMandatoryIndicator
	,BookTransactionScript = SRC.BookTransactionScript
	,InterestCalculationTransactionScript = SRC.InterestCalculationTransactionScript
	,DefaultClearingTransactionId = SRC.DefaultClearingTransactionId
	,DefaultInstrumentTypeId = SRC.DefaultInstrumentTypeId
	,EefcAccountIndicator = SRC.EefcAccountIndicator
	,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1 = SRC.CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1
	,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2 = SRC.CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2
	,CompoundingDateId = SRC.CompoundingDateId
	,FixedTermMonths = SRC.FixedTermMonths
	,FixedTermYears = SRC.FixedTermYears
	,FloatingInterestTableId = SRC.FloatingInterestTableId
	,FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths = SRC.FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths
	,FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays = SRC.FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays
	,RuleId = SRC.RuleId
	,LookBackPeriodForPastDue = SRC.LookBackPeriodForPastDue
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,PenaltyPayableIndicator = SRC.PenaltyPayableIndicator
	,FinancialProductNatureId = SRC.FinancialProductNatureId
	,PsFrequencyCalendarBase = SRC.PsFrequencyCalendarBase
	,AdditionalCalendarBase = SRC.AdditionalCalendarBase
	,MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator = SRC.MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator
	,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName = SRC.AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName
	,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription = SRC.AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription
	,FinancialProductSerialNumber = SRC.FinancialProductSerialNumber
	,GlobalFinancialProductId = SRC.GlobalFinancialProductId
	,IslamicFinancialProductTypeId = SRC.IslamicFinancialProductTypeId
	,OriginationChannelId = SRC.OriginationChannelId
	,ServicesChannelId = SRC.ServicesChannelId
	,DepositWindowPeriod = SRC.DepositWindowPeriod
	,DepositWindowPeriodEndDate = SRC.DepositWindowPeriodEndDate
	,ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate = SRC.ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate
	,CoolingPeriodMonths = SRC.CoolingPeriodMonths
	,CoolingPeriodDays = SRC.CoolingPeriodDays
	,PdIndicatorId = SRC.PdIndicatorId
	,FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths = SRC.FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths
	,FreezeInactivityPeriodDays = SRC.FreezeInactivityPeriodDays
	,RpcPurposeId = SRC.RpcPurposeId
	,SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
	,SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId = SRC.TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId = SRC.WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct SRC
	ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId

INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProduct
	(FinancialProductId
	,FinancialProductName
	,ProductFirstSaleDate
	,ActualAbandonmentDate
	,MinimumAgeToOpenAccount
	,LedgerId
	,TransactionReportCodeIndicator
	,TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication
	,EmployeeId
	,NewAccountDuration
	,DormantAccountCriteria
	,FxTransactionIndicator
	,StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator
	,FcnrIndicator
	,InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId
	,InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator
	,AccountMaintenancePeriod
	,MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent
	,CommitCalculationMethodId
	,InactiveAccountChargeDays
	,InactiveAccountChargeMonths
	,DormantAccountChargeDays
	,DormantAccountChargeMonths
	,PartitionMandatoryIndicator
	,BookTransactionScript
	,InterestCalculationTransactionScript
	,DefaultClearingTransactionId
	,DefaultInstrumentTypeId
	,EefcAccountIndicator
	,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1
	,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2
	,CompoundingDateId
	,FixedTermMonths
	,FixedTermYears
	,FloatingInterestTableId
	,FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths
	,FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays
	,RuleId
	,LookBackPeriodForPastDue
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,PenaltyPayableIndicator
	,FinancialProductNatureId
	,PsFrequencyCalendarBase
	,AdditionalCalendarBase
	,MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator
	,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName
	,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription
	,FinancialProductSerialNumber
	,GlobalFinancialProductId
	,IslamicFinancialProductTypeId
	,OriginationChannelId
	,ServicesChannelId
	,DepositWindowPeriod
	,DepositWindowPeriodEndDate
	,ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate
	,CoolingPeriodMonths
	,CoolingPeriodDays
	,PdIndicatorId
	,FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths
	,FreezeInactivityPeriodDays
	,RpcPurposeId
	,SourceCode
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	FinancialProductId
	,FinancialProductName
	,ProductFirstSaleDate
	,ActualAbandonmentDate
	,MinimumAgeToOpenAccount
	,LedgerId
	,TransactionReportCodeIndicator
	,TransactionReferenceNumberMandatoryIndication
	,EmployeeId
	,NewAccountDuration
	,DormantAccountCriteria
	,FxTransactionIndicator
	,StopTypeOfTransactionIndicator
	,FcnrIndicator
	,InterestPaidCollectionCurrencyId
	,InterBranchClosureAllowedIndicator
	,AccountMaintenancePeriod
	,MinimumCommitChargeUtilizationPercent
	,CommitCalculationMethodId
	,InactiveAccountChargeDays
	,InactiveAccountChargeMonths
	,DormantAccountChargeDays
	,DormantAccountChargeMonths
	,PartitionMandatoryIndicator
	,BookTransactionScript
	,InterestCalculationTransactionScript
	,DefaultClearingTransactionId
	,DefaultInstrumentTypeId
	,EefcAccountIndicator
	,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage1
	,CombinedStatementSchemeLevelMessage2
	,CompoundingDateId
	,FixedTermMonths
	,FixedTermYears
	,FloatingInterestTableId
	,FloatingRepricingFrequencyMonths
	,FloatingRepricingFrequencyDays
	,RuleId
	,LookBackPeriodForPastDue
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,PenaltyPayableIndicator
	,FinancialProductNatureId
	,PsFrequencyCalendarBase
	,AdditionalCalendarBase
	,MudarabahPoolFinancialProductIndicator
	,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductShortName
	,AlternateLanguageFinancialProductDescription
	,FinancialProductSerialNumber
	,GlobalFinancialProductId
	,IslamicFinancialProductTypeId
	,OriginationChannelId
	,ServicesChannelId
	,DepositWindowPeriod
	,DepositWindowPeriodEndDate
	,ToleranceLimitDepositWindowPeriodEndDate
	,CoolingPeriodMonths
	,CoolingPeriodDays
	,PdIndicatorId
	,FreezeInactivityPeriodMonths
	,FreezeInactivityPeriodDays
	,RpcPurposeId
	,SourceCode
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
